g.text: Rastok — semantic ownership (v17; not a Rust API inventory)
no application mailbox, var or handler
private var; one Dispatch per trigger
exactly one root Graph; no manager
typed external events; no journal writes
Generic lifecycle records may name a Graph.
They are not Graph application transactions.
Hosts: Operator, Graph, finite outbound Call.
Exhaustion is LoopExpired on existing err,
custom terminal, or the Call's extended exit.
Commands are not ports or spatial edges.
